# Introduction

Teams begin bringing their final projects together and preparing to communicate their findings.

2. Improve data visualization and communication

4. Prepare project documentation

Guidance and support for final project development and communication.

# Lab - Final Project Work

Teams refine analysis, visualizations, documentation, and deliverables.

# Discussion - Project Feedback

Teams review their progress and receive feedback on their final project.

# Assignment

Continue final project development and prepare materials for final submission.
